blocks.text: Let's solve this one step by step. Three times the quantity x plus four, plus two x.
Distribute first. Three times x is three x, and three times four is twelve.
Now combine the x terms. Three x plus two x is five x. Twelve has no like term, so it stays.
So the answer is five x plus twelve.
Watch out for these traps. If you multiply only the x by three, you get five x plus four. If you add three and four instead of multiplying, you get five x plus seven.
